- Docs: We'll issue a private-offer PO that explicitly anchors billing to Oct 1 and includes the pre-activation clause.

Option B (standard term):
- Term: 12 months (Oct 1, 2027 — Sep 30, 2028)
- Pricing: Redwood 12-month standard pricing (no uplift)
- Activation: Immediate activation with standard billing cadence.
